t70a_sha.headline: AI Detected
flagged: AI-Generated (101 words): What showed me that the daytime pl/ork had stayed shallow was the difference at night. If your dream that night carries far more feeling and need than the session came anywhere near, that's the sign this is you (a session that was good and just didn't stick around is something else). Then ask what that dream let you feel that the session didn't, and how you understand it now. And if nightmares start wrecking your sleep, do less of the practice, earlier in the day or for a shorter time, before you write off the whole thing.
